question: Among product categories (English names) with at least 500 delivered order items, which category has the highest share of late-delivered items (delivered after the estimated date)?
sql:
WITH delivered AS (
    SELECT 
        oi.order_id,
        oi.product_id,
        o.order_delivered_customer_date,
        o.order_estimated_delivery_date,
        p.product_category_name
    FROM order_items oi
    JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
    WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered'
),
category_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        ct.product_category_name_english AS category,
        COUNT(*) AS total_items,
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN d.order_delivered_customer_date > d.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 
                ELSE 0 
            END) AS late_items
    FROM delivered d
    JOIN category_translation ct 
        ON d.product_category_name = ct.product_category_name
    GROUP BY ct.product_category_name_english
    HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500
)
SELECT 
    category,
    CAST(late_items AS DOUBLE) / total_items AS late_share
FROM category_counts
ORDER BY late_share DESC
LIMIT 1
